description: This file defines a class 'PDF' that extends the FPDF library, providing additional methods for creating custom PDF documents, including drawing shapes, adding images, text blocks, tables, and other specialized elements for report generation.

classes.name: PDF
classes.description: A custom PDF class extending FPDF to facilitate advanced PDF report creation with additional drawing and layout methods.

methods.name: RoundedRect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners using Bezier curves.

methods.name: _Arc
methods.description: Helper method to draw an arc in the PDF document.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.description: Applies rotation transformation to the coordinate system for drawing rotated elements.

methods.name: _endpage
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to reset rotation after page end.

methods.name: sizeOfText
methods.description: Calculates the number of lines needed to display a text block with given width.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into the PDF at specified location.

methods.name: addCompany
methods.description: Adds company name and address block into the PDF.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Creates a labeled block with a total inside a rounded rectangle.

methods.name: addTextBlock
methods.description: Adds a simple text block with title and content.

methods.name: tableWrapper
methods.description: Draws a table wrapper with lines for headers.

methods.name: addBubble
methods.description: Draws a bubble (rounded rectangle with content) with a title.

methods.name: addBubbleBlock
methods.description: Draws a bubble block (rounded rectangle with content) with a title.

methods.name: addRecBlock
methods.description: Adds a record block with a title and data inside a rounded rectangle.

methods.name: addDescBlock
methods.description: Adds a description block with a title and multiline content inside a rounded rectangle.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a simple line at specified position.

methods.name: addCols
methods.description: Adds column headers to a table with separators.

methods.name: addLineFormat
methods.description: Sets the format for each column in a table.

methods.name: addProductLine
methods.description: Adds a row of product data in a table.

methods.name: addTotalsRec
methods.description: Draws a totals section with lines and labels.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Adds a watermark text with rotation to the PDF.
